jobs.description: This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: United States About us: Jerry.ai is a profitable, Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. We’re building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with the car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat) and accelerating our growth. About this role: We’re at an inflection point in our journey. After 2 years of profitable growth with a stable core business (car insurance marketplace), we’re ready to expand our product offerings and accelerate customer growth. We’re looking for 2-3 Senior Product Managers to drive progress across one of our key new product bets, including motorcycle insurance (just launched), home insurance (also just launched), new insurance products for other assets like boat and RV (concept phase), as well as non-insurance products to make car and home ownership easier such as helping customers save money on their property taxes (about to launch). Each of these new product areas comes with its own operational or technical challenges, its own customer pain points, and its own path to scale. And we’re looking for builders who are excited to build from scratch and own one of our new bets. Why you will (or won't) like working here: • 0-to-1 scope: The products you will work on are new territory for us. There are no established frameworks, no prior PM who has figured it out. • Product complexity: Property tax rules vary county by county. Specialty vehicle insurance involves regulatory and product complexity that doesn't exist in standard auto. These are not clean, well-scoped problems to solve. • Big responsibility & impact: You will have meaningful ownership. And what you do will likely materially impact the trajectory of our business over the next few years. What you'll own: There are several new product bets in the motion. The specific product you will work on will largely depend on your prior experience, interests/preferences, and our business priorities when you join the team. The goal in every case remains the same: ramp quickly on a new domain, distill data and insights to identify the highest leverage areas to prioritize (including quantitative data from our Data Science team and qualitative data from our Customer Insights & Research team), build and ship new products, get customer feedback quickly, apply learnings and iterate, and compound on what works. Whether it’s home, motorcycle, boat or RV products, you will be a key contributor to our product roadmap and own execution from early concept or early launch to finding product-market fit, and scaling. Who you are: • A first-principles thinker: You approach problems with curiosity and use data to develop clear hypotheses before you reach for a solution. You're analytically strong but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?" • An owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane. • Empathetic & Curious: You care deeply about understanding what drives how they think, feel and behave. • Diligent: Your follow through is impeccable. When you own something, nothing falls through the cracks. What you bring: • 4+ years in management consulting (MBB or equivalent), consumer-facing product management, or equivalent role at a high-growth startup • Consumer product instincts, either from direct product building experience or from close work alongside consumer product teams • Comfort with data: able to run your own analysis and build conviction from messy signals While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted. Please note: Jerry.ai is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX
